dialysisApp.heading: Dialysis Companion App
dialysisApp.subheading: Already Live and improving quality of life for dialysis patients every day. Our app gives patients and care teams a complete picture of what matters most.

features.title: Potassium Tracking
features.description: Log and monitor potassium levels with trend analysis to stay within safe clinical ranges.

features.title: Protein Monitoring
features.description: Track daily protein intake to support muscle health and meet dialysis dietary requirements.

features.title: Intradialytic Fluid Tracking
features.description: Record fluid intake during dialysis sessions for accurate clinical review.

features.description: Monitor fluid accumulation between sessions to reduce complications and hospitalizations.

features.title: Nutrition Diary

features.title: Medical Diary
